title: Reference: API error codes
question: How should the error code reference be organised?

options.label: Alphabetical
options.description: Every code in one list. Fast when you already know the code.

options.label: By endpoint
options.description: Codes grouped under the endpoint that returns them. Best when you arrive from a failing call.

options.label: By cause
options.description: Grouped as client, auth, rate limit and server errors, with a section nav.

content: There are about 60 error codes. Engineers land here from a log line or a failed request and want the meaning and the fix quickly.
